title: labels.json
description: Design contracts v1 (family 'design', DESIGN §6; frozen at merge: additive change = minor bump, breaking change = human-gated). Geographic label objects for the U13 label system (pads, stations, scored sites, user points, landmarks, overlay labels). Coordinates are filled by the pipeline (pipeline/export/labels.py, WS16) from the referenced files; 6 decimals. Codes are unique within the file (checked by the producer's test; JSON Schema cannot express it).

code.description: short uppercase label code (DESIGN U13), e.g. PAD, P2, S7, U1, MSH

kind.description: object kind; the placement order is config/design.yaml labels.priority (selected -> pad -> route_station -> station -> scored_site -> user_point -> landmark -> overlay; 'selected' is a runtime state, never a kind). pad = official pad (PAD) and parking options (P2-P4); station = S1, S2, S4 ...; scored_site = S6-S8; route_station = optional, for a station or site on the official route (the app re-ranks route stations from the active plan's route, so station / scored_site are equally valid for them, as in the §6.2 example); user_point = U1-U3 (normally created in the app, same shape); landmark = config/landmarks.yaml (D33: verified coordinates only); overlay = overlay feature labels (shown only when zoomed in)

status.description: landmark naming status (IAU official or informal, U13); null for every other kind

priority.description: 1 = highest; becomes the symbol sort key (lower draws first and wins collisions)

minzoom.description: first zoom at which the label shows (config/design.yaml labels.minzoom: landmark 6, pad 10, station 13, overlay 15)

maxzoom.description: optional: last zoom at which the label shows (absent = no limit)

ref.description: where the position comes from: a data path relative to the data root, optionally with '#id' (pad.json, stations.json#S7, scenarios/pads/index.json#rank2) or a config file (landmarks.yaml)

bearing_deg.description: optional: bearing from the official pad, deg clockwise from north (landmark hover text)

dist_m.description: optional: distance from the official pad, m (landmark hover text)
